title: Stakeholder analysis — power and interest
source: Joann's five-loop systems map (Stakeholder analysis + systems map V2).
framing: Separate from the systems map and deliberately so: this answers who can move the system, not how the system moves. Members are individually low-power but collectively decisive — mass churn is the real source of member power, and it enters the map through partner coverage.

quadrants.label: Manage closely
quadrants.guidance: High power and high interest. These decide whether the work proceeds.

quadrants.label: Keep satisfied
quadrants.guidance: High power, low interest. They will not follow the detail, but they can stop it.

stakeholders.name: Finance & Risk
stakeholders.note: Liability owners — and the owners of the breakage brake.

quadrants.label: Keep informed
quadrants.guidance: Low individual power, high interest. Collectively decisive: mass churn is the real source of member power.

stakeholders.name: Everyday active members
stakeholders.note: The primary user in the team's product definitions.

stakeholders.name: Earn / redeem partners
stakeholders.note: The supply side of partner coverage.

quadrants.label: Monitor
quadrants.guidance: Low power, low interest. Watch for change rather than manage.

stakeholders.name: Prospective members / public
stakeholders.note: The prospect who weighs a join offer before becoming a member.
